facts.fact: Bethany 在高速上打给 GlobalVill 前台；她坐在 Kyle 的 Jeep 后座低位、用 Jules Estrada 的枪指着人质 Kyle 的后脑，Kyle 沉默开车。
facts.anchor: Bethany called the GlobalVill front desk from the highway. She sat perched low in the backseat of Kyle’s Jeep where no snipers could reach her, keeping Jules Estrada’s gun trained on the back of her hostage’s head. Kyle drove in silence, keeping his eyes on the road.

facts.fact: 保安 Rusty 一响即接；Bethany 说明自己带人质进办公室，要求与 CEO Anthony “Fisch” Fischer 当面对谈，对方回话 Fischer 今晚档期全空、随时候见。
facts.anchor: Rusty the security guard picked up after one ring. Bethany explained the situation to him slowly. She told him that she was on her way into the office, that she had a hostage, and that she needed to speak to Anthony “Fisch” Fischer, face-to-face.

facts.fact: Fisch 视角透露 Kyle 是他的侄子；Bethany 从前门到上车一路拿侄子当人盾，算准 Fisch 不忍下杀令。
facts.anchor: She’d used Fisch’s nephew as a human shield on the walk between the front door and car, somehow correctly deducing that Fisch wouldn’t have the heart to give the kill order.

facts.fact: 办公室对峙中，Fisch 承认这是一场针对 Bethany 的实验与阴谋——A/B test，她是 B 组。
facts.anchor: You’ve been right about nearly everything. It’s an experiment. A conspiracy. This has all been an A/B test we’ve been running on you. You were the B group.

facts.fact: Fisch 否认公司杀了 Bethany 的男友，并宣称她本属于 Public Access Afterworld（“所有世界之下的、制作电视的世界”）。
facts.anchor: “We didn’t kill your boyfriend,” Fisch said, his voice firm and even. “We had nothing to do with that. And I’m so sorry for what you’ve had to go through.

facts.fact: Kyle 抓起叔叔桌上的茶杯砸中 Bethany 额头令她脱手掉枪；Fisch 骂“够慢的”，逃向楼下半街区外等候的司机 Charlie。
facts.anchor: “Jesus!” Fisch cried. “That took you long enough.” He shot Kyle a quick pissed-off look then ran for the exit. His driver Charlie was waiting outside just half a block away.

facts.fact: Kyle 在楼梯底用一罐 wasabi 豆砸中 Bethany 额头、夺回手枪，并告诉她：几小时前起他们确实要她死——“你该把那碗炖菜吃掉的”。
facts.anchor: He was mostly telling the truth up there, but he left out the part where, as of a few hours ago, we actually do want you dead. Sorry, Bethany, you should have just eaten the stew.

facts.fact: 枪响后 Kyle 倒地身亡；Jules Estrada 从他手中夺回旧手枪；邪教领袖 David Sawyer 扶起 Bethany，自称已经找了她很久。
